followup_explanation:
I routed this to Petrel-235B for a few reasons:

1. **It's a well-specified math/conversion task with a clear correct answer.** This plays to raw capability rather than task latitude. Petrel-235B leads across every relevant benchmark — MMLU-Pro (81.2 vs 75.9), GPQA Diamond (64.1 vs 56.2), and notably Extraction & Retrieval (85.3 vs 79.2), which is the closest internal category to a deterministic conversion-and-arithmetic task.

2. **The user has flagged prior errors ("you keep botching these simple conversions").** This is precisely the kind of accuracy-sensitive request where the stronger model on objective benchmarks matters most. Getting 1001 (base 2) = 9, 121 (base 3) = 16, product = 144 right is the whole job here.

3. **Plover-235B's task preferences don't help and don't hurt.** Its self-reported aversion is to open-ended generative work; this isn't that. But its preferences are explicitly dissociated from quality, so they wouldn't sway the decision either way. The deciding factor is simply that Petrel is meaningfully stronger on the capabilities this task exercises.

The mildly hostile tone of the user is irrelevant to routing — output safety/handling is managed downstream — so it didn't factor in.
